note: Reviewed power tiers for Version 2 research moves (editorial gameplay calibration by the project lead; rubric in docs/option-c/POWER_TIERS.md). Every listed tier is tied to a feat or technique in that character's own research record by tools/build-research-moves.cjs. Characters not listed stay at the standard research strength (tier 2).
